en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajaj who said,

‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What is your<sup>asws</sup> view, if I was needy to a physician and he was a Christian, should I greet upon him and supplicate for him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, (but) your supplication will not benefit him’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Abd al- Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who has said the following:
‘‘Once I asked abu al-Hassan Musa (a.s.) ‘If I needed to visit a Christian physician, can I offer the greeting of peace and pray for him?’ The Imam said, ‘Yes, but your prayer will not benefit him.’”
